findings.title: Stats page crashes on a malformed stats response and sticks on 'Loading stats…' with the old table still shown
findings.expected: A visible error such as 'Could not load harvest stats.', no uncaught error, and no stale results
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')" (stats.plants.length); the page stays on 'Loading stats…' and keeps showing the previous range's table and best plants as if they were current
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Loading stats…"],"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]} | {"alerts":["Loading stats…"],"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]}

findings.title: Stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever, with no error or retry
findings.expected: After a reasonable wait, an error and a way to try again
findings.actual: After 14 s the page still shows 'Loading stats…' above the old range's table, with no timeout, error or retry
